_meta: Build personalizable adversarial review — named refuter PROFILES (persona + optional model + domain falsification lens + verdict policy). Design: planning/refuter-profiles-scope.md. Three requirements: (1) DEFAULT ALWAYS WORKS — a gate with NO profile (and no HB_REFUTER) dispatches a refute prompt BYTE-IDENTICAL to today (persona stays in the backend; the feature is opt-in and cannot break/fail-open existing projects); `default` is a shipped, resolvable profile you OPT INTO (name it / HB_REFUTER=default) that composes a better baseline (generic-skeptic persona + the gate's review_questions); an unknown EXPLICIT name errors, never silent no-review. (2) USER-CREATABLE + SHAREABLE — a shipped library plugin/templates/refuters/<name>.json, bootstrap-seeded into .hb/refuters/ exactly as executors are (bootstrap.sh copies templates/executors/), project files shadow shipped, `hb refuters` discovery; sharing = drop a JSON / PR it to the shipped library, no code change (the domain-adapter distribution model). (3) PARITY — resolve/compose/discovery/panel are a node≡python twin (hb-exec.js ≡ executor.py, cli.py ≡ hb.js), mirrored and parity-cased. All THREE refute surfaces (node exec, python exec, interactive skill review_pending) share ONE compose via a new `hb refute-prompt <gate>` command, so the interactive path is behaviorally the same proven compose — not a doc grep. Composes OVER the existing refute path (review.prompt, cross-model refute_*, HB_ACTOR distinct-actor, review_questions). Determinism boundary: gate the plumbing (resolve/compose/discovery/default/backward-compat/invariants), never the LLM's judgment.

Drive BOTH runtimes (parity oracle). --selftest proves each field, each precedence tier, and the unknown-errors path individually load-bearing → SELFTEST-OK. RED before rs2.

phases.title: Compose via one shared `hb refute-prompt` across all three surfaces + backward-compat + parity

tasks.title: Spec-first: author the compose proof (backward-compat, coverage-narrowing, fail-closed teeth)
tasks.description: Author docs/howto/gate-examples/refuter-compose.sh (prints REFUTER-COMPOSE-OK) driving the new `hb refute-prompt <gate>` command (the single compose used by all three surfaces). Assert: (A) BACKWARD-COMPAT — a gate with NO profile and no HB_REFUTER yields a refute prompt byte-identical to the pre-change dispatch (just review.prompt / the 'Refute that {g}' fallback; no persona/questions injected), so existing projects are untouched; (B) NAMED profile — the composed prompt CONTAINS persona + the gate's base review_questions + the profile's extra questions + review.prompt, and profile.model/provider reach the refute dispatch (observed via a STUB backend that echoes prompt+model); (C) COVERAGE-NARROWING teeth — a profile with its own questions must APPEND to, never REPLACE, the gate's base review_questions (mutating compose to replace goes RED); (D) an unknown profile named on a gate makes the DISPATCH error non-zero (review not skipped — fail-closed at the compose site, not only the resolver); (E) distinct-actor (HB_ACTOR) + fail-closed unchanged. Drive BOTH runtimes (byte-identical). --selftest proves A–E each load-bearing. RED before rc2.

tasks.title: Implement compose + the `hb refute-prompt` command in node AND python
tasks.description: Add `hb refute-prompt <gate>` (py cli.py + node hb.js, parity) that prints the composed refute prompt for a gate: resolve profile (RS/RL) → persona + review_questions(base + profile.questions, APPEND) + review.prompt; no profile ⇒ emit exactly today's prompt (backward-compat). Route profile.model/provider. Wire the automated review_pending dispatch (executor.py:315-328 and the hb-exec.js twin) to use this same compose. Unknown profile errors. Preserve distinct-actor + fail-closed. Shared tick.py untouched.

tasks.title: Parity case + wire the compose proof + dev-tests
tasks.description: Add a tests/parity.sh case asserting `hb refute-prompt` composes an identical prompt node≡python for a fixture profile+gate. Wire refuter-compose.sh into tests/run-tests.sh (marker same-line) + dev-tests.md row. Update parity-notes.md (compose / refute-prompt is part of the shared refute surface).

tasks.title: Route the interactive (skill) review_pending refuter through `hb refute-prompt` — the third surface
tasks.description: Update the interactive review_pending path — plugin/skills/heartbeat/SKILL.md and the PROTOCOL guidance — so a spawned-Agent refuter (Claude Code / Codex) is seeded by running `hb refute-prompt <gate>` (the SAME proven compose the automated path uses). This makes the highest-traffic surface behaviorally identical to the gated compose, not a separate prose path, so an interactively-run refutation honors review.profile.

tasks.title: Spec-first: author the panel proof (RED-capable, teeth)
tasks.description: Author docs/howto/gate-examples/refuter-panel.sh (prints REFUTER-PANEL-OK). With verdict {panel:N, refute_if:'majority'|'any'|'all'} on a profile, assert the dispatch runs N refuters and aggregates correctly (majority => refuted iff > N/2; any/all likewise); with no panel the single-verdict path is unchanged; fail-closed holds (any panelist with no verdict => cannot certify a pass). STUB verdicts (deterministic, no model). Drive both runtimes (identical aggregation). --selftest proves majority/any/all each load-bearing. RED before rp2.

tasks.title: Implement panel aggregation in node AND python
tasks.description: When profile.verdict.panel > 1, run N refute dispatches and aggregate by refute_if (default single verdict when absent). Fail-closed if any panelist yields no boolean verdict. Mirror exactly across executor.py and hb-exec.js.

tasks.title: Wire the panel proof + dev-tests + parity case
tasks.description: Wire refuter-panel.sh into tests/run-tests.sh (marker same-line) + dev-tests.md row; add a parity.sh case that panel aggregation is identical node≡python; note it in parity-notes.md.
